;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Eastern Daraa offensive (June 2018)]]
**[[Russia]]n warplanes provide air cover for the offensive for the first time. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-russia/russian-jets-strike-rebel-held-town-in-syria-opposition-sources-idUSKBN1JJ15F (Reuters)]
*[[Timeline of the Israeli–Palestinian conflict|Terrorism in Israel]]
**[[Shin Bet]] and the [[Israel Defence Forces]] detain eight suspected terrorists, including one suspected of conducting a [[vehicle-ramming attack]] earlier in the day. Guns, cash, and stun grenades are seized. [https://www.jpost.com/Breaking-News/Terror-suspect-responsible-for-car-ramming-attack-surrenders-560711 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
;Arts and culture
*[[Women to drive movement]]
**[[Saudi Arabia]] lifts its ban on women being allowed to drive. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2018/06/23/saudi-arabia-driving-ban-women-finally-lifts/728403002/ (''USA Today'')]
;Disasters and accidents
*An explosion in [[Wuppertal]], [[Germany]], destroys a building and injures at least 25 people, four of them seriously. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/germany-explosion-wuppertal-injured-building-latest-injured-a8414161.html (''The Independent'')]
*Firefighters extinguish a blaze on [[bulk carrier|bulk freighter]] MV ''Iron Chieftain'', which was burning for almost a week while docked at Port Kembla in [[New South Wales]], [[Australia]]. Police say they will remain on-scene to assist the owner and operator with [[marine salvage|salvage operations]]. [https://www.illawarramercury.com.au/story/5485749/after-almost-a-week-port-kembla-ship-fire-totally-extinguished/ (''Illawarra Mercury'')]
;International relations
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**16 [[European Union]] leaders meet in advance of the 28 June full EU summit on migration. [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/at-mini-migration-summit-eu-nations-try-to-resolve-differences (PBS Newshour)]
**Two ships, MV ''Lifeline'' and MV ''Alexander Mærsk'', carrying hundreds of rescued migrants, await a port to disembark. The commercial [[Maersk]] ship rescued migrants following a request from [[Italy|Italian]] authorities but Italy and [[Malta]] have refused permission to dock. [http://www.dw.com/en/malta-italy-migrant-spat-leaves-german-rescue-ship-in-limbo/a-44368470 (Deutsche Welle)] [http://www.euronews.com/2018/06/25/ship-carrying-over-100-rescued-migrants-refused-right-to-dock-in-italy (euronews)]
**Politicians from [[Germany]], [[Spain]], and [[Portugal]] visit MV ''Lifeline'' amid negotiations for the ship to dock in [[Malta]] or [[Italy]], both of which have refused permission. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/06/25/europe/migrant-ships-lifeline-maersk-stranded-mediterranean-intl/index.html (CNN)]
;Politics and elections
*[[Turkish general election, 2018]]
**Voters in [[Turkey]] go to the polls for a [[Turkish presidential election, 2018|presidential]] and [[Turkish parliamentary election, 2018|parliamentary]] election. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-election/turks-vote-for-president-parliament-in-crucial-test-for-erdogan-idUSKBN1JJ16V (Reuters)]
**Incumbent [[President of Turkey]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] claims victory as preliminary results show him winning a majority of votes. [http://www.afr.com/news/world/europe/turkey-election-president-recep-tayyip-erdogan-claims-victory-20180624-h11t2h (''Australian Financial Review'')]
